d:
Delhi University’s first four-year undergraduate batch under the National Education Policy (NEP) graduated in 2026, expecting a pathway to a one-year master’s programme. But a new admission priority system has left students questioning their eligibility and future academic plans. With students approaching the Delhi High Court, what went wrong with NEP’s promise? Watch our ground report.
